content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] with [version_no], have enabled web server access (HTTP) and configured a web user. I'm utilizing the message text function block with both web server and [product_name] display enabled. When I attempt to access the web server from my browser, I only see the readme [document] rather than the actual login page. With earlier [version_no] models, I never encountered this issue. Does anyone have suggestions for resolving it?
If you are only seeing the readme [document], it means the web server may not be activated properly.
I'm certain the web server is activated. I tested accessing it from my mobile phone, and it worked without any problems. The issue was limited to my computer.
Try pressing Ctrl-Shift-R in your browser to perform a hard page reload (which avoids cached content).

analysis.insight_summary: The main problem described is that when users try to access the web server of a [product_name] with [version_no] from a computer browser, only the readme [document] appears instead of the login page, even though setup procedures were properly followed. Access from mobile devices works as intended, suggesting the issue relates to browser cache or settings on the computer rather than a configuration error with the device. This situation causes confusion and limits the ability to use web-based features from PCs.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the web server's login page to appear correctly in their computer browser after proper setup, just as it did with previous [product_name] and [version_no] models.
